about_the_game:
Welcome to the largest "Falsehood" in human history.

Redshift Point is a first-person survival extraction RPG that fuses modern Chinese industrial aesthetics with a near-future collapse. Forget the neon-drenched, shallow "Cyberpunk" clichés. We are here to offer a dose of Sino-Industrial Rationalism.
No more Cyber Blink!

We have had enough of the westernized "Cyberpunk" visual tropes—endless neon lights and exoticized "future cities" that serve no purpose. In Redshift Point, we returned to the roots of the 21st-century Chinese industrial soul and merged it with 20th-century socialist aesthetics.

  • We don't believe in "RPG numbers" floating in the air. Combat in the Nova Exclusion Zone is about physics, momentum, and the brutal reality of ballistics.

    • Authentic Ballistics: If your kinetic energy doesn't beat the armor plate, you achieve nothing. We focus on the visceral feedback of machinery and lead.

    • Hardcore Survival: Every shot matters. We prioritize the "feel" of the weapon over the stats on a screen. This is professional-grade physical intervention.

We don't believe in "RPG numbers" floating in the air. Combat in the Nova Exclusion Zone is about physics, momentum, and the brutal reality of ballistics.

  • Authentic Ballistics: If your kinetic energy doesn't beat the armor plate, you achieve nothing. We focus on the visceral feedback of machinery and lead.

  • Hardcore Survival: Every shot matters. We prioritize the "feel" of the weapon over the stats on a screen. This is professional-grade physical intervention.

In the year 2037, the crisis isn't just about AI or corporate greed; it’s about the Commodification of Existence.

  • In the Exclusion Zone, we don't care about the labels assigned to you by "Global Corporate Ethics" . To the Megacorps, your identity is just another product to be exploited.

  • We believe in the collective struggle of the "disposable" worker and soldier. Whether you are a Scavenger or a Soldier, you are being exploited by the same invisible hand.

  • Those forced to perform "Identity" to survive are the truly marginalized. We reject the divisive politics of the elite. Here, everyone's life is a resource—and it’s time to take that resource back.

content_descriptors.notes:
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence, General Mature Content.

Red-Shift Point is a survival shooter that features intense, realistic combat scenarios. This includes depictions of blood, bodily injury, and death inflicted by firearms and other weapons against human and mechanical enemies. The game also contains moderate profanity, depictions of criminal acts, and references to alcohol and tobacco use suitable for a gritty, post-apocalyptic setting.

name: Red shift Point

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires an SSD for optimal performance and a stable network connection for cloud-based AI inference and event calculation; no multiplayer mode available.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires an SSD for optimal performance and a stable network connection for cloud-based AI inference and event calculation; no multiplayer mode available.

short_description: Red-Shift Point is a first-person survival shooter set in 2037, where players become soldiers or scavengers in a chaotic future world. Engage in tactical combat against mechanical foes, manage resources, and influence the game's evolving story through strategic decisions and immersive gameplay.
supported_languages:
English*, German, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
